lines.text: America and Britain almost went to war over a pig.

parts.tts: America and Britain almost went to war over a pig.
parts.heard: America and Britain almost went to war over a pig.

lines.text: In 1859, on an island both sides claimed, a British company's pig got into an American's garden.

parts.tts: In eighteen fifty-nine, on an island both sides claimed, a British company's pig got into an American's garden.
parts.heard: In 1859, on an island both sides claimed, a British company's pig got into an American's garden.

lines.text: He offered 10 dollars. The British wanted 100.

parts.tts: He offered ten dollars. The British wanted one hundred.

lines.text: Britain threatened to arrest him... so America sent soldiers.
Soon, 461 American troops faced five British warships.

parts.tts: Soon, four hundred sixty-one American troops faced five British warships.

lines.text: Nobody fired a shot. The only casualty... was the pig.
